C1.rationale: The only hard, unconditional constraints concern irreversibility (no lossy edit to an every-turn file without per-candidate confirmation) and each states why; everything else is delegated to a stated judgment question the model can generalise from, and the confirmation shape is derived from a principle (how lossy) rather than enumerated by convenience.

evidence.quote: The deciding question is **"must this be true on every turn regardless of what the user asked?"**
The confirmation shape depends on **how lossy the disposition is**, not on convenience.

C2.rationale: The decision surface is enumerated at the point of declaration (six dispositions with a signal column, a seven-option approval menu, two confirmation tiers) and the invalid combination is named impossible rather than merely discouraged; the argument surface itself is typed with an explicit default, but `argument-hint` restates `args` verbatim and conveys nothing the declaration does not, so the interface is not quite self-sufficient on its own.

evidence.quote: `scope-path` (optional, default `.`) — the directory whose `CLAUDE.md` and `.claude/rules/` are audited.
Drop, Consolidate-that-deletes, and Promote-to-skill are never batched, regardless of audit size.

C3.rationale: The skill directory holds exactly one file (13,784 chars, no supporting files, no scripts): the core path, the full disposition rubric, the execution-mechanics table, a report template, an anti-patterns table, and a rare path that only applies at ~15+ candidates are all inlined together, so nothing is deferred to a separately-loadable file — the pointers it does carry are to other units' rules, not to its own deferred detail.

evidence.quote: For a **small audit** (fewer than ~15 candidates) the per-item loop is cheap — prompt each candidate individually and skip batch mode.

C4.rationale: Overlapping guidance is consistently pointed at rather than restated, and the ownership boundary is drawn explicitly in both directions — the skill positions itself against its three nearest siblings and names which surface owns the cost model and the plugin-lifecycle mechanics; the sibling `evaluate-plugin/skills/evaluate-context-engineering/SKILL.md` independently defers migration to this skill ("This skill measures and recommends; it does not rewrite"), and no `.claude/rules/*.md` file duplicates the diet rubric. The only copies are two cited numbers (the chars/4 proxy and the ≤150-char target), each carrying its owner inline.

evidence.quote: Cost model: `skill-quality.md` (listing budget, `skillListingBudgetFraction`) and `skill-development.md` (path-scoped rule frontmatter, description front-loading).
**Inverse** of `session-distill` (*creates* rules from sessions), orthogonal to `meta-promote` (moves config *between scopes*).

C5.rationale: This is a SKILL.md body, not an always-loaded surface — it costs tokens only once its intent fires, so the always-loaded budget dimension does not apply.

C6.rationale: The genuinely mechanical half of this audit — enumerating the always-loaded set, measuring each file, converting to an estimated token count, and computing the net always-loaded delta for the final table — is described in prose for the model to re-derive on every run, where a bundled script emitting structured output would state it exactly; the only executable delegation is the two `find` commands in the Context block, and there is no `scripts/` directory in the skill at all.

evidence.quote: For each file, record its size (`wc -c`, est. tokens ≈ chars/4 — same proxy as `skill-quality.md`)
Emit a final table and the net context saving:

top_finding: Extract the deterministic half of the audit — always-loaded file discovery, `wc -c` sizing, token estimation, and the net-delta arithmetic — into a bundled script the skill runs, which simultaneously earns back C6 and lets the rare-path batch-approval and report-template material move out of the single 13,784-char body.
counter_finding: The destructive-vs-non-destructive confirmation tier table earns every token it costs: it draws an irreversibility boundary (a lossy edit to an every-turn file degrades every downstream turn) at exactly the point a capable model would otherwise batch for convenience, and it says why, so it generalises to dispositions the table does not enumerate.

leakage.note: Three files on the hard-constraint do-not-read list (skill-quality.md, skill-development.md, skill-evaluation.md) were auto-injected into context by the repo before I could avoid them; I did not open them deliberately. I explicitly withheld every excluded house criterion from scoring: the unit's `## When to Use This Skill` table and its absent `## Agentic Optimizations` table were treated as neither credit nor debit; its 13,784-char size was not scored against the 10,000/26,000 gates (C3 was scored on disclosure structure — one file, no supporting files, a rare path inlined — which stands independently of any threshold); the absence of a literal `REFERENCE.md` was not itself the defect; and the description length, model tag, and date frontmatter were ignored. One residual exposure worth naming: `offload-to-deterministic-substrate.md` states a principle close to C6's anchor, but C6 here was scored on the published shift (prose spec vs runnable artifact) and the concrete observation that the skill ships no scripts.
